title: The White, the Yellow, and the Black
writer: Antonio Troiso, Marcello Coscia, Sergio Spina
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Tomas Milian, Eli Wallach
plot: In the 19th century, when the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians but Sheriff Gideon aided by an inept Japanese servant offers to deliver the ransom.
